    Searched docs for "Content Security Policy CSP header configuration"

    Base44 response

    Content-Security-Policy headers aren't configurable at the app level on Base44 — only Prevent Embedding (X-Frame-Options) and Restrict Browser Features (Permissions-Policy) are, which you can toggle on from your app's Dashboard → Security → Settings. If you need full CSP support, you'd have to request it from Base44 support as a platform feature.

    Connect my Google Calendar to the Live TV page so I can automatically display and update the schedule of movies airiApp overview MyVJ — All Translated Movies is an lifestyle app built around a media-localization system called Veejay. It helps viewers access international films, TV series, and documentaries by presenting them in languages they understand, so foreign entertainment feels accessible and enjoyable.

    How Veejay works Veejay converts foreign-language videos into localized versions by supplying either translated subtitles or dubbed tracks in the user's preferred language. This removes language barriers and makes content from around the world easier to follow for domestic audiences.

    Notable capabilities Customizable subtitle appearance and timing to suit individual reading speed and visual preferences A broad catalog of international films, series, and factual programming Dual localization options: choose between translated subtitles or dubbed audio Free access to the app and its translated content An intuitive, easy-to-navigate interface designed for comfortable viewing Viewing experience and controls The app focuses on a smooth playback experience: toggling subtitle or audio language is simple, and common playback controls are clearly laid out. Subtitle formatting (size, color, and position) can be adjusted so text is readable without disrupting the picture. Overall, the design emphasizes comfort and ease of use.

    Reasons to try it If you want to broaden your exposure to global cinema without struggling with unfamiliar languages, MyVJ provides a straightforward solution. It’s especially useful for users who prefer either reading translated text or listening to localized audio, and for anyone seeking a free, user-friendly way to discover foreign titles.

    Recommended alternative Consider Vj Luganda Translated Movies Free if you’re specifically interested in Luganda-language localizations or want an app focused on that regional audience. It serves as a complementary option for viewers looking for translations in particular languages or dialects.
